title: Hidden evaluation run during the Q course

tellings.quote: it was an evaluation for another unit in the military above you know these units

plain: Randy Anderson, a former soldier who says he saw alien technology at a military base, talks about the Q course, the US Army's demanding course for becoming a Special Forces soldier. He says that while he was going through it, a secret evaluation was quietly being run on the candidates for another military unit ranked above those units. He tells it to explain how he may have been picked out for work beyond ordinary Special Forces.
